text.title: FreshDrop CEO pitch to the board, 15 September 2026
text.audience: board members; they worry about margin; they have tried a price cut before; if nothing changes, churn grows
text.a1: in 2026 a missed slot costs a family an evening
text.b1: a dinner on time with one tap in the app
text.a2: couriers come in a 2-hour window and families wait at home
text.b2: a fixed slot and a reminder 15 minutes before
text.a3: the shop is out of stock for the items on the list
text.b3: the family orders the same basket in one tap
text.a4: the slot is gone when they check at 19:00
text.b4: the courier calls at the wrong time
text.a5: the slot is booked on the first tap
text.ask: approve the slot pilot budget of 4 million rub by 1 October 2026
text.bliss: every family gets dinner on time and the courier never misses a slot
text.decision: the board is to decide on the pilot; the story lacks the margin numbers for the second year
